result.reason: The added clause appropriately provides up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates and requires machine-readable data return and deletion certification. However, the data-export deadline runs from Corio’s request rather than from expiration or termination. Because a request could occur later—or not at all—the operative language does not ensure export within 30 days of termination as required by both the preferred and fallback positions. The change is otherwise targeted and professionally drafted.
